LAREDO, Texas — Three people were booked into the Webb County Jail on Wednesday, October 21, 2026, on alleged misdemeanor charges, according to public booking records.

LEONARDO FLORES-CALVA — Flores-Calva was booked on an alleged charge of displaying a fictitious license plate, a Class B misdemeanor. The arrest was made by the Laredo Police Department. The booking record did not list a bond amount.

ARTURO VILLARREAL — Villarreal was booked on an alleged charge of driving while intoxicated, a Class B misdemeanor. The arrest was made by the Webb County Sheriff's Office. The booking record did not list a bond amount.

GAEL GARCIA — Garcia was booked on an alleged charge of assault causing bodily injury to a family member, a Class A misdemeanor. The arrest was made by the Laredo Police Department. The booking record did not list a bond amount.

All charges are allegations. Each person is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.

*Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search; Webb County public-access court records.*

*— Walter Webb & Willa Webb, News Anchors, Webb Watch 956*
